app.message: Kubernetes has one flat pod network: network membership does not isolate services
tmpfs /tmp/scratch of service cache counts against its memory limit
Bind source /var/cache/local must exist on every node that may run cache
Service queue is a StatefulSet; replicas are replaced one at a time, stop-first
Traefik labels in labels are used on Kubernetes; on Swarm Traefik only reads deploy.labels
volume queue_data is stored in the claim queue-data
